deploybot: Scheduled rollout for tenant halcyon -> dedicated slice-12 tonight 23:00 UTC. Release artifact: redwood/runtime:v2.4.1-rc3. Pin runtime 2026-03-02-rt9. Change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Canary 5% then 25% then 100% with hold gates.

sam: ack. I'll own canary monitoring and traces.

lina: I'll watch dashboards + infra alerts (pager duty on). Which alerts are our canary gates?

miguel: quick note - security: no KMS rotation for this push, using existing key. Audit logs exported to splunk/halcyon.

sam: canary gates: 
- error-rate > 2% for 5m -> rollback
- p95 latency increase > 30% baseline for 10m -> rollback
- token throughput degradation > 20% for 10m -> pause and investigate

lina: copy. I'll add those as synthetic checks in the dashboard and tie to the canary alert channel.

ops-bot: Preflight checks: GPU allocation OK, disk usage OK (<55%), network egress OK, service-account perms verified. All green. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: Starting canary at 23:00 UTC. Rollout plan (automated):
```
# start canary
deploybot start-rollout --tenant halcyon --slice slice-12 \ 
  --image redwood/runtime:v2.4.1-rc3 \ 
  --runtime-pin 2026-03-02-rt9 \ 
  --canary 5 --hold 10m
# after canary
deploybot traffic-shift --tenant halcyon --slice slice-12 --to 25 --hold 15m
deploybot traffic-shift --tenant halcyon --slice slice-12 --to 100
```

sam: I'll post periodic updates here. If I see anomalies I'll call rollback and ping #incidents.

miguel: If we need manual rollback the command is:
```
deploybot rollback --tenant halcyon --slice slice-12 --to-image redwood/runtime:v2.4.0 --reason "canary-failure"
```

lina: quick prod note: retention spike expected in traces during canary, ignore noise below 50ms sampling.

deploybot: Canary scheduled. ETA start 2321122334 (23:00 UTC). Will post status updates in-thread.

sam: GO for canary. I'll be online for the first 30m. :eyes:

lina: GO. I'll escalate if the synthetic gates fire. :arrow_up:

miguel: GO from security/ops.

ops-bot: Reminder: rollback playbook pinned -> /playbooks/rollbacks/halcyon.md. Ensure on-call has access.

deploybot: Starting canary: 5% traffic -> slice-12 at 23:00:10 UTC. Will hold at 10m gate.
